purpose: The architecture in detail: the long-form rules that CLAUDE.md summarises.
details: Moved word for word out of CLAUDE.md on 16/11/2026 so CLAUDE.md stays short. Read the part about the area you work on. It is the reference for any change: layers, storage and stability rules, the fixed method (klad, tips, cheat sheet, second chance, stopping), how to add a topic or an input kind, word problems, points/passwords/reports/the stop lock, mixed practice (kern/reeks.py), Taal (StappenHulp), Werkwoordspelling data, the beta screens with panels, and the menu structure (Vak > Domein > Onderwerp from terminal/curriculum).
summary: Detailed architecture notes: layers (kern without curses, terminal, venster, inhoud), data/storage/stability rules, the fixed work method with F1 tips and the cheat sheet, how to add a topic (Onderwerp subclass + learning-line JSON + catalogus + curriculum line) or an input object, the word-problem machine (structure × world × wording), points/passwords/reports/stop lock, mixed practice, Taal and Werkwoordspelling building blocks, the beta panel screens and the curriculum-driven menus.
